variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question
variants.body: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: The leadership of a political party is under challenge. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
